title: San Diego Electric Bike Rental
includes: Half-Day (up to 4 hours) or Full-Day (up to 8 hours) Electric Bike Rental (chosen at booking)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover San Diego like never before with an electric bike rental from Wheel Fun Rentals –the ultimate way to cruise the city with ease. Skip the traffic and parking hassles and glide through vibrant neighborhoods and to must-see spots like Balboa Park and Mission Bay. Our premium e-bikes make it easy to cover more ground, climb hills with ease, and enjoy every mile in comfort. Whether you’re chasing ocean views, exploring hidden gems, or just soaking up the SoCal sun, an e-bike adventure turns every moment into an unforgettable ride.

All electric bike rentals must be returned by end-of-business on the same day; no overnight rentals are available. 

Electric Bike Riders must be 16 years of age or older and wear a helmet regardless of age.
